shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot on a school training pitch in late afternoon: cones in a line on the grass, a plain white ball beside them. The coach, a man of 45 with short grey-flecked hair, a light grey polo and a plain whistle on a cord, holds a clipboard and talks with Mert, a boy of 16 in a plain navy training kit, who stands with a water bottle in one hand. Low sun, long shadows, green fence behind. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.

Warm low light, blurred cones behind. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.
